cases.title: Desktop sans Chrome
cases.expected: Connect/search/save selected draft with Chrome closed and same data root

cases.title: Handshake/version/capabilities
cases.expected: Only actual commands advertised; unsupported old backend gives actionable protocol error

cases.title: Read scope + command injection
cases.expected: Write/job/executable/argv/SQL fields rejected before owner effects; no second store/worker

cases.title: UTF8/JSON/schema faults
cases.expected: Strict UTF8, duplicate keys, NaN, malformed/trailing JSON, wrong operation and unknown fields rejected

cases.title: Combined pipe/output limits
cases.expected: stdout+stderr bounded together; both pipes drained; overflow typed error, no raw content diagnostics

cases.title: Timeout/close cleanup
cases.expected: Child stopped/reaped, pipes closed; UI responsive; no worker descendants or stale callbacks

cases.title: Reconnect generation
cases.expected: Late reply from old child cannot modify new namespace/query/connection UI

cases.title: Same loaded-profile identity
cases.expected: Profile changed between requests returns actual request binding; wrong store/profile/adapter reply rejected

cases.title: Ready store and missing prerequisites
cases.expected: Missing Python/Tk/backend/profile/store gives SETUP_REQUIRED; no empty replacement corpus or migration

cases.title: Bounded search/full inventory distinction
cases.expected: Top matches labelled limited; inventory continuation to EOF when supported; no global 20-file cutoff

cases.title: Selected context digest/source eligibility
cases.expected: Exact items/text/backend digest; stale IDs or unsupported eligibility fails visibly; no pointer/raw override

cases.title: Draft/file identity
cases.expected: Goal/scope/criteria + SELECTED_ITEMS binding; canonical_task_id null; file hash separate from owner digest

cases.title: Atomic draft faults
cases.expected: Disk full/interruption/output conflict no false saved state; earlier output/corpus retained

cases.title: Windows spaces/Unicode/repeat launch
cases.expected: Configured argv paths work; repeated launch namespace/store identity same

cases.title: Keyboard/main-thread UI
cases.expected: Tab/Enter/Escape/cancel work; no Tk calls from worker, labels treated as text

cases.title: Browser/native compatibility
cases.expected: Legacy wrapper and dispatch return same domain results; installed browser path continues

cases.title: Uninstall/rollback preserves data
cases.expected: Remove only owned shell; corpus sentinel/backend/profile/outputs and browser reads survive

cases.title: Version/resource receipt
cases.expected: Actual shell/backend/Python/Tk/OS/corpus identities, memory/latency and NOT_RUN gaps recorded
